data.name: Farouq
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Quran (Quran 25:1), Farouq is an attribute of Allah, denoting His ability to distinguish truth from falsehood.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Farouq is given to a child in the hope that he will grow up to be a just ruler, capable of distinguishing truth from falsehood.

in_arabic.name: فاروق

data.cultural_impact: The name Farouq gained significance due to its association with the great medieval caliph, Al-Farouq, who ruled the Islamic empire in the late 9th and early 10th centuries. During his reign, he established a golden age in Islamic history, characterized by the development of science, art, literature, and lauded for his military prowess. The name was also popular among Sufis (Islamic mystics), as one of the Ninety-Nine Beautiful Names of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Quran, Allah says to Prophet Muhammad v.53, "O you who believe! Call upon Allah with truth; He will confirm the signs for you. But when He tests you with a affliction, on those days invoke the Name of Allah and remember Him abundantly." Farouq as a name carries the spiritual weight of inspiring its bearer to seek the truth and recognize it, as Allah does, and to rely on the divine power and guidance in times of trial. It is a constant reminder of the importance of honesty, steadfastness, and fathoming the mysteries of the divine.
